title: Gavel: Agent Meets Checklist for Evaluating LLMs on Long-Context Legal Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2601.04424v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now support contexts of up to 1M tokens, but their strengths and weaknesses on complex long-context tasks remain unclear. To study this, we focus on multi-document legal case summarization, where a single case often spans many documents exceeding 100K tokens. We systematically evaluate 12 frontier LLMs with Gavel, which consists of Gavel-Ref, a reference-based evaluation framework with checklist, residual-fact, and writing-style evaluations, and Gavel-Agent, a reference-free agent for evaluating factual coverage directly from source documents. Our results show that current models are more prone to omitting key information than hallucinating. They all perform well on simple checklist items, such as filing date, but struggle with rare and complex items, such as settlements. Performance also declines as case length increases. translated_title: Gavel：智能体与清单结合评估大语言模型在长上下文法律摘要中的表现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.04424v4 公告类型：替换  摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）现在支持长达100万token的上下文，但它们在复杂长上下文任务中的优势和劣势仍不清楚。为研究这一点，我们聚焦于多文档法律案例摘要，其中单个案例通常跨越多个文档，超过10万token。我们使用Gavel系统评估了12个前沿LLM，该系统包括Gavel-Ref（一个基于参考的评估框架，包含清单、残余事实和写作风格评估）和Gavel-Agent（一个无参考的智能体，直接从源文档评估事实覆盖度）。我们的结果显示，当前模型更容易遗漏关键信息而非产生幻觉。它们在简单清单项（如提交日期）上表现良好，但在罕见和复杂项（如和解协议）上表现挣扎。性能也随案例长度增加而下降。为元评估Gavel，我们收集了160小时的人工标注。Gavel-Agent减少了……
tldr: 本研究提出Gavel系统（含Gavel-Ref和Gavel-Agent）评估12个前沿LLM在长上下文法律摘要中的表现，发现模型主要问题是遗漏关键信息而非幻觉，且性能随案例长度增加而下降。
en_tdlr: This study introduces Gavel (with Gavel-Ref and Gavel-Agent) to evaluate 12 frontier LLMs on long-context legal summarization, finding that models primarily omit key information rather than hallucinate, with performance declining as case length increases.
